leads.query: site.indiacode.nic.in api act metadata open data download
leads.observations: Search snippets distinguish the commercial eCourtsIndia service from government India Code and report its old free API withdrawn. NyayKosh is a different NeGD initiative, not evidence that the original India Code connector works.
leads.decision: Do not substitute a paid wrapper or unrelated corpus; government policy retry remains on saved backoff.

leads.query: site.nhm.gov.in guidelines metadata API publications catalogue
leads.observations: A separate support-agency publication list may hold NHM guidance; relationship and exact original-catalog provenance unverified. No claim of current NHM search success.
leads.decision: Retain lead for explicit program/document identity mapping, not automatic connector replacement.

leads.query: site.bloomlibrary.org public API catalog download metadata OPDS anonymous
leads.observations: Search-index result still describes provider-issued enterprise or partnership access. Reuses previously captured primary documentation; no fresh authenticated request.
leads.decision: Owner-approved key/access agreement or a published anonymous export is required; no account/outreach under this run.

leads.query: site.oercommons.org metadata API export OAI search API
leads.observations: Search did not establish a supported current OER Commons export/API; unrelated OAI-PMH documentation is not a provider contract.
leads.decision: No new query route or speculative endpoint probe.

leads.query: site.indiacode.nic.in API metadata acts download XML
leads.observations: Official old homepage search result explicitly announces migration to indiacode.gov.in. This is a useful published-route trigger distinct from blind retry of the timed-out old host.
leads.decision: Preflight the newly advertised official host before requesting its public catalog.

leads.query: site.inflibnet.ac.in Shodhganga metadata IndCat SRU API
leads.observations: Operator features page advertises links to full-text Shodhganga theses and SRU bibliographic retrieval. Whether SRU exposes these thesis links is not yet established.
leads.decision: Read primary documentation and test only an explicit published method with native Shodhganga record mapping; do not treat generic IndCat book records as Shodhganga.
